jobs.title: Senior Data Analyst, Product
jobs.description:
About Hello Heart:

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the role

Hello Heart is seeking a talented and impact-driven Senior Data Analyst, Product   to join our ML team. In this role, you will shape the future of the digital health products that help people understand and improve their heart health. By applying your technical skills, analytical mindset, and product intuition to rich real-world health and behavioral data, you will help define the experiences we build for our users and the value we deliver to employers and health plans.

You will collaborate with a wide range of cross-functional partners across Product, Engineering, Data Science, Data Engineering, Clinical, Marketing, and Customer Success. You will use data and analysis to identify and solve our biggest product challenges, influence product strategy and investment decisions, and translate insights into digital solutions that improve the well-being of the people we serve.

What you'll do

- Product leadership: Use data to shape product development, quantify new opportunities, and identify upcoming challenges. Help your partner teams prioritize what to build, set goals, and understand their product's ecosystem, ensuring what we build brings real value to users, clients, and Hello Heart.

- Analytics: Guide teams with data and insights. Develop hypotheses and test them using a varied toolkit of rigorous analytical approaches, from experimentation to causal inference and statistical modeling.

- Communication and influence: Don't just present data, tell data-driven stories. Influence partners with clear insights and recommendations, and become a trusted strategic partner through structure and clarity.

Your responsibilities

- Work with large and complex datasets, applying statistical analysis and visualization methods to extract meaningful patterns and trends.

- Identify and measure the success of product efforts through goal setting, forecasting, and monitoring of key product and engagement metrics.

- Design, execute, and analyze A/B tests, including tests of ML-driven features, accounting for cause/effect and treatment/prevention relationships.

- Monitor and analyze the performance of our ML models in production, and generate insights and research leads for model improvements and new data-driven solutions.

- Define, understand, and test opportunities and levers to improve the product, and drive roadmaps through your insights and recommendations.

- Partner with Product, Engineering, Data Science, and healthcare professionals to inform and execute product strategy.

- Integrate AI tools into your workflows to drive measurable gains in efficiency and quality.

- Stay current with the latest research and best practices in healthcare analytics and AI.

Requirements

- Bachelor's degree in Statistics, Mathematics, Computer Science, Engineering, or another quantitative field.

- 4+ years of hands-on experience in analytics or data science, solving analytical problems using quantitative approaches.

- Proven experience leading data-driven projects from definition to execution, including defining metrics, designing experiments, and communicating actionable insights.

- Strong knowledge and experience with SQL.

- Proficiency in Python (Pandas, NumPy, SciPy) and in data visualization.

- Familiarity with experimental design and statistical modeling techniques (e.g., Bayesian methods, propensity score matching).

- Experience analyzing or testing the performance of ML models in production.

- Hands-on experience using AI tools to support data analysis, coding, research, and problem solving.

- Strong analytical and critical thinking skills, with excellent communication and storytelling ability.

Hello Heart has a positive, diverse, and supportive culture - we look for people who are collaborative, creative, and courageous. Oh, and if you want to see some recent evidence of the fun things we do at Hello Heart, check out our Instagram page .

jobs.description:
About Hello Heart:

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

We’re an AI company focused exclusively on heart health, building a platform that predicts and prevents cardiac events before they happen—identifying risk up to 10 days in advance versus 10 years in traditional clinical models.

This is already working at scale. Hello Heart has been shown to reduce inpatient hospital days by 47% and deliver ~$1,800 in annual savings per member. Hello Heart is the cardiac prevention partner to over 80% of large U.S. health plans and serves hundreds of public and private employers.

We’re defining how the #1 cause of death—heart disease—is managed in the AI era. Join us.

About the role:

Hello Heart is looking for a curious, analytical, and action-oriented Senior Product Analyst to join our Product Team. In this role, you will be the data leader within your product area, helping the team make data informed decisions, identify opportunities, and measure the impact of product initiatives.

Reporting into our Hello Meds GM, you will partner closely with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Business Intelligence Developers, and Software Engineers to turn complex data into clear insights that shape product strategy, roadmap decisions, and business planning.

You will play a key role in understanding how members interact with the Hello Meds product, where we can improve their experience, and how we can better support their long-term success.

Responsibilities:

- Partner with Product Managers and cross-functional stakeholders to support data-informed product decisions, roadmap planning, and business strategy.

- Analyze user behavior, product usage, funnels, and engagement trends to identify opportunities to improve the member experience and product outcomes.

- Build, maintain, and improve dashboards, reports, and alerts using business intelligence and analytics tools.

- Define, track, and evaluate key performance indicators and reporting frameworks that help the business understand product performance.

- Translate complex data sets into clear insights, actionable recommendations, and concise narratives for product, leadership, and business teams.

- Design and analyze product experiments, including A/B tests, funnel analysis, and other methods that measure the impact of product changes.

- Partner with Data Engineering, Business Intelligence, and Engineering teams to ensure data quality, reporting accuracy, and reliable measurement.

- Proactively surface trends, anomalies, and risks in the data, bringing findings and recommendations to Product Managers and stakeholders ahead of requests, not just in response to them.

- Define and build analytical frameworks to empower product and analytics teams with standardized, high-impact insight generation.

- Define and build analytical frameworks to empower product and analytics teams with standardized, high-impact insight generation.

Qualifications:

- 5+ years of experience in product analytics, data analytics, business intelligence, or a related analytical role.

- Experience with product development, A/B testing, funnel analysis, and business-to-consumer applications is a strong advantage.

- Advanced SQL skills, with strong experience analyzing complex data sets and building clear, scalable reporting.

- Experience with business intelligence and analytics tools, such as Mixpanel, Tableau, Looker, or similar platforms.

- Bachelor’s degree in a quantitative, analytical, technical, or business-related field, or equivalent practical experience.

- Strong understanding of statistical analysis and product experimentation. Experience with R, Python, MATLAB, or similar tools is an advantage.

- Ability to communicate insights clearly and translate data into actionable recommendations for technical and non-technical audiences.

- Strong AI fluency, with the ability to use AI tools and agent-based workflows to accelerate analysis, summarize findings, improve productivity, and enhance decision-making while applying sound judgment and data privacy practices.

- Strong problem-solving skills, independence, curiosity, and a proactive, go-getter mindset, with a track record of surfacing risks, gaps, or opportunities before being asked rather than only responding to requests.

- Highly organized and detail-oriented, with the ability to manage multiple priorities and adapt quickly in a fast-moving environment.

- Passion for data, product impact, and using insights to improve the user experience.

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

About the Role

As Senior Product Manager for Hello Meds, you’ll own and drive our medication adherence and optimization product across software, connected hardware, and the operational systems that bring them together.

Hello Meds combines Pillbox, our connected medication device; Nia, our AI-powered assistant; and Med Review, our pharmacist-led medication optimization service. You’ll work closely with Engineering, Product Design, and Client Experience to execute the product strategy, scale the member experience, and shape the next generation of Hello Meds and Pillbox.

This is a highly cross-functional role for a product leader who is equally comfortable owning software experiences, navigating complex operational workflows, and partnering deeply with hardware and firmware engineering.

Responsibilities

- Own and prioritize the Hello Meds product roadmap across the member experience, Pillbox, and supporting operational workflows

- Drive product development in partnership with software, hardware and firmware engineering, and design

- Translate member, client, and product data into clear requirements and priorities that improve activation, engagement, and retention

- Own and improve critical eligibility and enrollment workflows across client populations

- Partner with Client Experience and implementation teams to enable smooth client onboarding and launches

- Own Pillbox product and firmware requirements, translating real-world device performance into engineering priorities

- Lead Pillbox V2 planning, including feature prioritization, firmware roadmap, accessibility, and usability requirements

- Represent Hello Meds product in client and internal stakeholder conversations and support product performance and outcomes initiatives

Qualifications

- 7+ years of product management experience, including direct experience managing hardware and/or firmware products such as connected devices, IoT, or medical devices

- Experience owning consumer-facing software products and roadmaps

- Demonstrated ability to manage complex eligibility, enrollment, operational, or data workflows

- Strong product judgment and ability to balance user needs, technical constraints, and business priorities

- Excellent communication and cross-functional leadership skills, including the ability to work effectively with technical and non-technical stakeholders

- Proven ability to drive execution with a high degree of ownership and operational rigor in a fast-moving environment

Preferred

- Experience in healthcare, digital health, medication adherence, or connected medical devices

- Familiarity with employer benefits or health plan eligibility systems

- Experience working with healthcare channel partners such as health plans, PBMs, or pharmacy networks

- Experience with accessibility standards or regulated device documentation

Hello Heart is on a mission to make heart attacks a thing of the past.

About the Role

Hello Heart is expanding into new clinical domains and user populations. As the Senior Product Manager for this new growth initiative, you'll execute the product strategy —taking a validated concept through market validation and into initial scale. You will define the playbook for how we build, test, launch, and scale new offerings that expand Hello Heart's impact beyond our core platform.

This is a founding PM role for a new product line. You'll work at the intersection of user research, engineering, design, and commercial execution—moving fast, validating assumptions, and building products that deliver measurable clinical and commercial impact in underserved populations.

Responsibilities

- Conduct deep user experience research (UXR) and market validation to test strategy assumptions and define product-market fit

- Lead product launch execution and initial go-to-market rollout

- Develop and execute growth strategies to drive user acquisition, engagement, and retention throughout the product lifecycle

- Drive product development in partnership with engineering, design, data science, and analytics teams

- Design and test service prototypes in collaboration with clinical, product, and GTM teams, with a focus on speed-to-learning.

- Work closely with Sales, Customer Success, and Clinical teams to understand customer needs and commercial viability

- Partner with the commercial team to validate market demand and ensure product-market fit before major investment

- Establish metrics for success and health checks that inform go/no-go decisions at key milestones

Qualifications

- Proven track record of 5+ years in product management roles within fast-paced, growth-oriented environments

- Demonstrated success developing consumer products from concept through launch, including defining product strategy and working under tight deadlines

- Strong analytical skills and experience with data-driven decision-making; ability to combine intuition with research

- Experience conducting user experience research (UXR) and translating user insights into product strategy

- Proficiency with A/B testing, experimentation, and iterative product development methodologies

- Excellent communication and collaboration skills; ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders

Preferred

- Experience in healthcare, digital health, or B2B2C product environments

- Track record launching or scaling products in adjacent markets or new product lines

- BS or MS in Engineering, Computer Science, Math, Physics, Statistics, or related quantitative field

- Experience in a high-growth, resource-constrained environment
